ImageDescription.value: Blarney - Blarney Woollen Mills - Crystal Blarney Woollen Mills is one of the best places to shop in Ireland, especially when they have a special sale that encourages people to drive there from other parts of Ireland. If you can't find what you are looking for here, you probably won't find it anywhere else, as they have a huge variety of items for sale here, such as clothing, jewellery, crystal, china, calendars, CDs, chocolates, postcards, etc.
